title: The Stomach That Joined the Story

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager's stomach growls at the scariest moment of an elder's story: own it, or clutch it and hope.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder), an elder, is telling a spooky story by the fire. Everyone is leaning in. Just as (elder) whispers, "And then, out of the dark, there came a sound...", (subject)'s stomach lets out a long, low, rumbling growl, timed to perfection. Every head turns toward (subject.him/her).

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "That," says (subject) gravely, "was the sound." (elder) doesn't miss a beat. "Yes. Exactly like that." From then on, whenever the story pauses, the whole circle waits to see if (subject)'s stomach has anything to add. It does, twice. It's the best-received story of the season, and afterward somebody brings (subject) a bowl of food, "for the performer."

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) presses both hands over (subject.his/her) stomach and stares hard into the fire. The stomach growls again, this time in two parts, like a question and an answer. The children lose all control. (elder) gives up and says, "We'll finish tomorrow, after (subject) has eaten something." (subject) eats twice that evening, just to be safe.
